prop_language_desc: Language used in this addon's interface. Restart Blender to apply changes
prefs_restart_required: Restart Blender to apply the new language
prop_skn_mesh_format_desc: Choose whether the mesh should be kept as triangles or converted to quads
prop_skn_mesh_format_quads_desc: Attempts to convert triangles to quads
prop_skn_apply_seams_desc: Automatically detects and marks UV seams when importing an SKN
prop_skn_apply_vertex_groups_desc: Groups of vertices matter with skinning weights.
prop_skn_merge_by_distance_desc: Performs Merge > By Distance on vertices after importing SKN
prop_skn_merge_threshold_desc: Maximum distance to consider two vertices as duplicates when using Merge by Distance
prop_skn_default_material_color_desc: Applies the default LeagueBlender gray color to materials created when importing SKN
prop_skn_import_as_collection_desc_skn: Imports each SKN submesh as a separate object, grouped in a Collection named after the file
prop_skn_import_as_collection_desc_skl: Imports each SKN submesh as a separate object, parented to the Armature (which acts as the container)
prop_skl_bone_shape_desc: Visual shape of bones when importing a Skeleton (.skl)
prop_skl_show_in_front_desc: Draw the armature on top of other objects (In Front option)
prop_skl_only_desc: Imports only the Skeleton, without loading the SKN
prop_scene_auto_clip_end_desc: Adjusts the viewport and camera Clip End on the first import, preventing models from being clipped in large scenes
prop_scene_clip_end_distance_desc: Clip End value applied to all viewports and the active camera on the first import
op_import_skn_desc: Imports a Skinned Mesh (.skn) from League of Legends
op_import_skl_desc: Imports Skeleton (.skl) + Mesh (.skn) from League of Legends. The .skn must have the same name and be in the same folder.
msg_skn_imported_collection: SKN imported as Collection: {0} - {1:,} verts, {2:,} faces, {3} submesh(es)
msg_skn_not_found:
SKN not found: {0}
.skn must be in the same folder with the same name as .skl.
msg_imported_container: Imported (Armature as container): {0} - {1} joints, {2:,} verts, {3} submesh(es)
msg_export_select_mesh: Select an object of type MESH before exporting.
msg_export_no_armature: [SKN.dump({0})]: Mesh does not have an Armature modifier. Bind the mesh to a skeleton before exporting.
msg_export_no_material: [SKN.dump({0})]: No material assigned to this mesh. Please assign at least one material before exporting.
msg_export_empty_material_slot: [SKN.dump({0})]: Material slot {1} is empty. Fill or remove empty material slots before exporting.
msg_material_renamed: Material "{0}" ({1} characters) exceeds the {2}-character limit and was renamed to "{3}".
msg_uv_renamed: UV Map "{0}" renamed to "{1}" to match the material (mesh "{2}").
msg_uv_renamed_elimination: UV Map "{0}" renamed to "{1}" to match the material (mesh "{2}"), the only possible pair by elimination.
msg_uv_ambiguous: [SKN.dump({0})]: Could not determine which UV Map belongs to each material. Materials without a matching UV Map: {1}. UV Maps available without a matching material: {2}. Manually rename the UV Maps to match their corresponding material name before exporting.
msg_too_many_submeshes: [SKN.dump]: Too many materials assigned: {0}, max allowed: 32 materials.
msg_too_many_verts: [SKN.dump]: Too many vertices found: {0}, max allowed: 65535 vertices.
